study_identification_part.si_4_title: Dynamic gray matter volume changes in pediatric multiple sclerosis

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Linear mixed-effects models were used to estimate normative sex- and age-expected GM growth curves. The model included fixed effects for age, sex, magnetic field strength, and random effects.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: To estimate normative sex- and age-expected GM growth curves, using Matlab ' s ' fitlme ' function (Statistics and Machine Learning Toolbox), the following linear mixed-effects model was fitted voxel-wise to HC preprocessed GM maps: ... where Yij represents the GM amount at voxel level ... A bivariate normal distribution was assumed for the vector of random effects ( bi0 , bi1 ), independent of the homoscedastic normal error term.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Gray matter volume (GMV) at the voxel level was the response variable.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: In pediatric patients with MS, deviations from normative GM volume values at the voxel level were assessed at baseline and during the follow-up, using linear mixed-effects models.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The model included Age, Sex, Magnetic Field Strength (MFS) as fixed effects, and likely Age^2 and Age*Sex interactions given the inverted-U shape description and r-value reporting. It also included random effects (subject level).
